/mcp.title: Social Media MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor | Social0
/mcp.description: Schedule and publish social media posts from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. Add mcp.social0.app/mcp, sign in, then post to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and 5 more.

faqs.question: How do I schedule social media posts with MCP?
faqs.answer: Connect your social accounts in Social0, add https://mcp.social0.app/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor and sign in, then ask in plain words, for example: schedule this for tomorrow 9 AM on LinkedIn and X. The assistant calls schedule_post and Social0 publishes at that time.

faqs.question: Which AI assistants work with the Social0 MCP server?
faqs.answer: ChatGPT, Claude (web, desktop and Claude Code) and Cursor connect to the hosted server over OAuth. VS Code and other local MCP hosts use npx @social0/mcp with an API key. OpenClaw and Hermes use the Social0 skill.

faqs.question: Which platforms can it post to?
faqs.answer: X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest: whichever accounts you have connected in Social0.

faqs.question: Do I need a separate plan for MCP?
faqs.answer: No. MCP, the REST API and the CLI are on every plan, including Free, with the same posting limits as the dashboard.

homeFaqs.question: Does Social0 work with AI agents?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes. Connect via the MCP server at mcp.social0.app/mcp (ChatGPT, Claude, OpenClaw, and other MCP clients), use the REST API at api.social0.app/v1, or the official CLI (npm install -g social0). Agents draft, schedule, and publish through the same pipeline as the dashboard.

homeFaqs.question: How do I connect ChatGPT or Claude via MCP?
homeFaqs.answer: Add Social0 as a remote MCP server (mcp.social0.app/mcp) with an API key from Dashboard → Developer. Once connected, ask your agent to draft, schedule, or publish — posts show up in Social0 like any other.

homeFaqs.question: Does Social0 have an API and CLI?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes. REST API at api.social0.app/v1 (works great from Postman), MCP at mcp.social0.app/mcp, and npm install -g social0 for the CLI. Create API keys in Dashboard → Developer.

homeFaqs.question: What platforms does Social0 support?
homeFaqs.answer: Nine platforms today: Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, and Pinterest — for instant publish and scheduling. See the Platforms section on this page for the full list. Want another network? Email support@social0.app.

homeFaqs.question: Is there a free plan?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes. Free includes 3 connected accounts and 10 posts. No credit card required.

homeFaqs.question: How many social accounts can I connect?
homeFaqs.answer: Free connects 3, Creator 15, and Agency 59, then $1/month per extra account with no cap. Each connected profile counts once. See Pricing for the full breakdown.

homeFaqs.question: What types of content can I post?
homeFaqs.answer: Text, images, videos, carousels (multi-image), and platform-native formats where supported — so you can share the same content types you already post manually.

homeFaqs.question: Can I manage multiple brands or workspaces?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes on every paid plan. Create workspaces for separate brands or clients, connect accounts per workspace, and switch between them from the dashboard.

homeFaqs.question: Will my posts get less reach using Social0?
homeFaqs.answer: No. Posts go out through each platform's official APIs — the same channels legitimate schedulers use — so reach matches posting from the native app. Algorithms change, but we don't throttle or shadow your content.

homeFaqs.question: What happens if a platform fails to publish?
homeFaqs.answer: If one platform fails (for example due to an API error or rate limit), the other platforms will still publish normally. You'll see exactly which platforms succeeded and which failed.

homeFaqs.question: Can I cancel anytime?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes. No contracts and no cancellation fees. Cancel anytime from Billing; you keep access until the end of the current billing period.
